name: com.macxrbridge.xr
description: Unity Play Mode on a Meta Quest 3 from a Mac, like Quest Link on Windows — passthrough, anchors, MRUK room with labels, passthrough camera (PCA), environment depth and raycast, headset audio and microphone, microgestures — plus tools Quest Link does not have: mixed reality recording, live spectator stream, session record & replay (no headset needed) with deterministic perception tests, an in-headset debug overlay and performance HUD. Needs the OXRSys runtime fork from macxr-bridge/oxrsys.
